name: Reactive ion etcher
purpose: Pattern thin films and polymers with dry etching.
geometryBrief: Chamber, stage, RF/power rack, door and controls.
behaviorBrief: Layer-selective removal; anisotropy and mask consumption from calibrated curves.
inputs: Layer stack, resist openings, calibrated etch-rate/selectivity curves and exposure interval
outputs: Etched layer geometry, residual mask and depth map
acceptance: Use a one-material open window with a constant vertical removal rate. Before breakthrough, depth equals rate × time inside the opening and remains unchanged beneath an ideal mask.

name: ICP reactive ion etcher
purpose: Independent plasma and substrate bias control for research etches.
geometryBrief: Chamber, RF coil, chuck, load hardware and control screen.
behaviorBrief: Etch profile, selectivity and process limits; internal plasma field schematic only.
inputs: Mask profile, material stack and calibration grid for coil/bias settings
outputs: Etched cross-section, remaining mask and process-domain flag
acceptance: Hold out one measured cross-section inside the calibration range; compare trench depth and sidewall angle against its metrology uncertainty. A request outside the calibrated range must be flagged.

name: Deep silicon etcher
purpose: Form deep silicon structures, sieve channels and shank profiles.
geometryBrief: Chamber/load lock, chuck, pump stack and cabinet; confirm installed configuration.
behaviorBrief: Model depth, sidewall taper/scallops and masking, with recipe-specific calibration.
inputs: Silicon geometry, trench mask, cycle count and calibrated depth/scallop profile
outputs: Deep trench geometry with sidewall texture, depth and residual mask
acceptance: Run a constant-depth-per-cycle fixture. Cross-section depth must equal summed removal and the resolved wall must show the configured number of periodic scallops.

name: Ion milling
purpose: Physically remove thin-film material where suitable.
geometryBrief: Vacuum enclosure, ion source concept, sample mount and controller.
behaviorBrief: Directional sputter removal, redeposition proxy and shadowing.
inputs: Surface mesh, masking geometry, ion incidence vector and calibrated removal yield
outputs: Milled thickness map, directional shadow mask and optional redeposition estimate
acceptance: At fixed normal incidence, shield half a flat coupon with an ideal opaque mask. With redeposition disabled, protected material retains its height and exposed material loses the prescribed thickness.

name: Plasma asher
purpose: Remove residual resist or clean surfaces.
geometryBrief: Small chamber, electrode plates, door and control knobs.
behaviorBrief: Resist removal and possible surface modification, not full plasma chemistry.
inputs: Resist thickness, underlying material ID and calibrated removal function
outputs: Cleaned surface revision and residual resist thickness
acceptance: Strip two resist patches with different initial thicknesses. At a removal greater than the thinner patch but below the thicker one, only the thinner patch clears; neither thickness becomes negative.

name: Wet processing
model: Custom ReynoldsTech-style wet bench (exact model pending)
purpose: Develop, clean, selectively etch and rinse compatible samples.
geometryBrief: Exhaust hood, sash, chemically resistant basins, DI wand, controls, bottle storage.
behaviorBrief: Abstract process selection and material compatibility; no real chemical recipes.
inputs: Material stack, opening mask, abstract process ID and material compatibility table
outputs: Revised layer outline, undercut estimate and compatibility result
acceptance: Use an isotropic constant-speed fixture over a straight mask edge. Lateral undercut must equal vertical depth; an unsupported material pair must return an unresolved operation.

name: Wafer dicing
purpose: Singulate fabricated dies and electrode substrates.
geometryBrief: Enclosure, wafer frame, spindle, cutting stage and screen.
behaviorBrief: Kerf, die map, alignment, yield and edge-chipping proxy.
inputs: Parent wafer revision, die layout, cut paths and blade kerf
outputs: Child die IDs, parent links, kerf geometry and damaged-die flags
acceptance: Run two perpendicular centerline cuts through a rectangular blank. Create four child dies and reconcile die area plus the union of both kerfs with the starting area.

name: Wafer grinding
geometryBrief: Large enclosed grinder, chuck, spindle and load area.
behaviorBrief: Final thickness, bow and material-removal estimate.
inputs: Backside geometry, initial thickness field, material ID and removal map
outputs: Thinned substrate revision, residual thickness and estimated removed volume
acceptance: Apply a uniform removal below the initial thickness to a parallel-sided wafer. Final thickness and volume loss must equal the initial thickness minus removal and area × removal, respectively.

name: Chemical mechanical polishing
purpose: Planarize wafer surfaces and multilayer stacks.
geometryBrief: Platen, carrier, slurry delivery and lid.
behaviorBrief: Removal rate and final planarity approximation.
inputs: Height map, material regions, removal coefficients and planarization history
outputs: Post-polish topography, material-removal map and planarity metric
acceptance: For an ideal single-material plane and uniform removal field, the output must stay planar and shift by the prescribed removal amount at every sampled point.

name: Femtosecond micromachining
purpose: Cut fine structures in compatible flexible substrates.
geometryBrief: Enclosed laser cabinet, sample stage and camera optics.
behaviorBrief: Kerf and heat-affected zone model; establish exact tool/material capability before use.
inputs: Flexible substrate revision, programmed path, material-specific kerf and thermal calibration
outputs: Cut contour with kerf and heat-affected-zone estimate or unknown flag
acceptance: Cut one straight path using a constant-width fixture. The measured width must equal the specified kerf away from endpoints; a missing thermal calibration leaves the heat-affected width unknown.

name: Micro milling
purpose: Machine jigs, fixtures and larger microfluidic prototypes.
geometryBrief: Spindle, XYZ stages, workholding and controller.
behaviorBrief: Toolpath and removed volume; no collision-free physical claim.
inputs: Stock solid, fixture coordinate frame, cutter profile and toolpath
outputs: Machined solid, swept-volume record and fixture-interference flags
acceptance: Sweep a flat-ended cylindrical tool along a straight slot. Compare its simulated plan area with a radius-ended analytic slot, and its depth with the commanded plunge.

name: Wafer bonding
purpose: Join aligned wafer structures and sealed cavities.
geometryBrief: Bond chamber, wafer fixture, loader and control rack.
behaviorBrief: Alignment, bond area, interface voids and assembly state.
inputs: Two wafer revisions, face orientation, alignment transform, bondable masks and void map
outputs: Assembly revision with both parents, bonded area and interfacial void regions
acceptance: Offset two identical square bond pads by half their width along one axis. Their bonded area must halve in the void-free fixture; adding a known nonoverlapping void inside it subtracts its area.
